name: qwen3.8-27b-fp8.pro6000ws-256k-bf16kv-dflash2.on-demand
purpose: On-demand RTX PRO 6000 WS profile for Qwen3.8 27B with OFFICIAL FP8 weights (Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8, dtype=auto) + bfloat16 KV cache, 256K context, DFlash2 external block-diffusion drafter n=7 (syvai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-W4A16, W4A16 ~1.28 GB), vLLM v0.27.1 with the DFlash2 backport applied at boot. FP8 weights halve the per-step weight read on the bandwidth-bound single GPU vs the bf16 sibling — the lever the 4x3090-fp8 ~100 TPS reference exploits. bf16 KV is mandatory for the DFlash2 non-causal block attention (NOT fp8 KV).
